title: Reverse a text
prompt:
Write reverse_text(text) that returns the text backwards.
Try to do it with a loop first (slicing tricks like text[::-1] are allowed, but you learn more with the loop).
hints: Read the word 'stop' backwards by hand: which letter do you write first, and which last?
Strings can't be changed in place, so build a new one. Each letter you meet should go... where in the new string?
Plan: start with an empty result; for each letter of the original, put it in front of the result; return the result.

edge_hints.empty: The reverse of an empty text is an empty text. Make sure the function still returns '' and doesn't return None.
edge_hints.spaces: Spaces are characters like any other; they must stay and move too.
